summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing routine quarterly disclosure dates for its 2Q26 Production and Sales Report (July 28, 2026) and Financial Results (August 6, 2026), along with a webcast on August 7, 2026. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation content. It is a standard earnings calendar notice by a foreign private issuer. There are no terms, premiums, board recommendations, or structural mechanics to analyze. Nothing in the filing indicates a non-routine event that would trigger a special-situations classification.
